verdict.rationale: BVNK documents its own rules API (`POST /payment/v1/rules`) that links a fiat virtual account to a blockchain address. Incoming fiat is then automatically on-ramped to crypto and sent on, which is a genuine event-triggered automated action. However, the only documented rule type is this single fiat-to-crypto forwarding pattern. Webhooks only notify external systems and do not themselves execute actions, so they earn no credit here. missing for 10: general-purpose rule definitions with configurable triggers, conditions and actions across event types, management or listing of rules, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
